user: Deleting your last throw in the live scorer actually works now — the trash icon no longer silently does nothing.
what: The turns DELETE endpoint used to resolve the turn id from the match-id route param, so the delete button returned success while deleting nothing. The turn id now comes exclusively from the query param, so the trash icon really removes the last turn.
why: Correcting a mis-entered throw is how you keep the score honest — a false-success delete could silently leave a wrong score on the board.
next: Play a match, enter a wrong throw, and hit the trash icon on the latest turn — it now really removes it and restores the prior score.

user: New house rule on record: scores are always recomputed server-side — client totals are never trusted at the API boundary.
what: Documented the design convention the new turn-edit PATCH endpoint follows: raw darts in, engine-recomputed scores out, illegal edits rejected — plus the explicit route-param rule that prevents the silent-delete bug class.
why: Future endpoints (conquest state, stats writes) should follow the same pattern so database rows always stay engine-consistent.
next: See docs/wiki/rules/never-trust-client-scores.md before writing any new turn- or state-mutating API endpoint.
summary: Added docs/wiki/rules/never-trust-client-scores.md capturing the trust-boundary convention established by the PATCH turns API (commit bf1803e): validate raw darts via turn-edit.ts, recompute totalScore/remainingScore/isBust with the game engine, never persist client totals; also covers explicit route-param resolution (the DELETE params.id fallback bug). Renamed the file to a short stable id to avoid the W2 warning.

user: Second-tab safety: only the latest throw of a live leg can be undone, with clear errors
what: The turn-delete endpoint now rejects stale clients: finished matches/legs and non-latest turns get a 400 with a plain message, unknown turns a 404; the scorer shows an error toast on failure instead of corrupting state.
why: A forgotten second tab on the same match link could punch a hole in the score chain and silently corrupt every later score.
next: Open a live match in two tabs and try deleting an old turn — you'll get a clear refresh prompt instead of corruption.

what: Wiki updated for the turn-edit/delete fix wave: new learning on chalk errors vs app bugs, fix notes on the two gauntlet bug learnings, Turns API and test-suite pages refreshed.
why: Future sessions need to know the scorer bugs are fixed, how the fix works (own-chain prev-remaining + loadMatch rebuild + DELETE guard), and that gauntlet failures can be fixture errors.
